weakest_scene.visible_evidence: seg3:end and seg4:start-end tile the frame with graduation-cap/mortarboard icons (angled dark square + orange tassel), 17 of them at 'each = 0.3', to represent 5 degrees of extra heat in formerly redlined blocks; the scene title is also clipped to 'rmerly redlined neighborhoods' by the left frame edge.
weakest_scene.root_cause: The unit-icon lookup for this subject resolved to an unrelated default glyph (mortarboard) instead of a heat/housing mark, and the scene title is laid out wider than the frame so it is cropped rather than fitted.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Replace the icon-grid unit with a mark made of the subject — a row of house/block silhouettes reddening, or heat-shimmer tiles accumulating — so each unit visibly means 0.3 degrees of heat, and fit the scene title inside the frame so it reads 'Formerly redlined neighborhoods' in full.
